contentPattern: One cell: an optional placeholder image and the video URL as a link (YouTube, Vimeo, a direct .mp4/.webm file, or any embeddable page). With a placeholder the player loads on click; without one it loads when scrolled into view. Renders a 16:9 player at full content width.

optionNotes.light: No black letterbox behind the player (transparent background).

usage: News articles and video pages: an embedded video player within the article column.
reuseGuidance: Use for any single embedded video. For video teaser tiles linking to video pages use cards-video.
